value.behaviour: Unit tests for the pure page helpers and for Scene's active-page filtering.

tests.name: home page is DEFAULT_PAGE_ID while it exists
tests.given: pages [default, p2] reordered so p2 sorts first
tests.expect: getHomePageId returns "default" and an element without pageId resolves to it

tests.name: unknown pageId falls back to the home page
tests.given: an element with pageId "missing"
tests.expect: getElementPageId returns the home page id

tests.name: reconcilePages keeps both concurrent creates in the same order
tests.given: local and remote each add one new page at the same index
tests.expect: reconcilePages(local, remote) and reconcilePages(remote, local) both contain both pages in identical order

tests.name: reconcilePages takes the higher version per page
tests.given: a page renamed remotely with a higher version and a page tombstoned locally with a higher version
tests.expect: the remote rename and the local tombstone both win

tests.name: restorePages repairs malformed input
tests.given: undefined, garbage entries and a list where every page is deleted
tests.expect: each restores to a list with exactly one non-deleted page

tests.name: Scene serves only the active page
tests.given: a Scene with elements on two pages and setActivePage(options for page 2)
tests.expect: getNonDeletedElements holds only page-2 elements while getElementsIncludingDeleted holds all

tests.name: mergeActivePageElements keeps other pages untouched
tests.given: the active page's elements are replaced with an edited subset
tests.expect: other pages' elements keep identity and position; the edits are applied

style_from.reason: pure element-package test layout importing from ../src

value.behaviour: jsdom editor tests for page operations, isolation, per-page undo, viewport, export and file round-trip.

tests.name: create page switches to an empty page
tests.given: a rectangle on the default page, then the page-create button is clicked
tests.expect: h.state.pages has 2 non-deleted pages, activePageId is the new id, and h.app.scene.getNonDeletedElements() is empty

tests.name: only the active page is rendered and selectable
tests.given: rectangles on page 1 and page 2, page 2 active
tests.expect: selectAll selects only page 2's rectangle and clicking where page 1's rectangle is selects nothing

tests.name: new elements land on the active page
tests.given: page 2 active, a rectangle drawn and one pasted via addElementsFromPasteOrLibrary
tests.expect: both have pageId equal to page 2's id

tests.name: rename keeps the previous name on whitespace
tests.given: double-click a tab, type "  " and Enter, then type "Data" and Enter
tests.expect: the first leaves the name unchanged, the second sets it to "Data"

tests.name: reorder from the tab bar persists
tests.given: three pages and Alt+ArrowRight on the first tab
tests.expect: its position moves one right and the order survives serializeAsJSON -> loadFromBlob

tests.name: viewport is restored per page
tests.given: page 1 scrolled and zoomed, switch to page 2 then back
tests.expect: page 2 uses the default viewport and page 1 gets back its scrollX, scrollY and zoom

tests.name: undo stays on its page
tests.given: a rectangle drawn on page 1, switch to page 2, draw a rectangle, undo twice
tests.expect: page 2's rectangle is removed and page 1's rectangle is untouched

tests.name: last page cannot be deleted
tests.given: a single page
tests.expect: no page-delete button is rendered and executing actionDeletePage changes nothing

tests.name: deleting the active page activates a neighbour and undo restores it
tests.given: three pages, the middle one active with elements, then delete, undo, redo
tests.expect: after delete the next page is active and the page's elements are deleted; undo restores id, name, position, elements and makes it active; redo deletes it again

tests.name: image export contains only the active page
tests.given: rectangles on two pages, export the active page through exportScene with the elements the export dialog receives
tests.expect: the SVG contains one rectangle

tests.name: multi-page file round-trips
tests.given: two named pages with elements serialized with serializeAsJSON and loaded with loadFromBlob
tests.expect: pages (ids, names, order) and every element with its pageId are intact

tests.name: legacy file restores onto one default page
tests.given: a file with elements and no pages
tests.expect: pages equals one page with id DEFAULT_PAGE_ID and every element is visible on it

tests.name: search switches to the page of a result
tests.given: text "needle" on page 1 while page 2 is active
tests.expect: searching and focusing the match makes page 1 active

tests.name: a whole-scene load through updateScene keeps every pageId
tests.given: page 1 active, then API.updateScene({ elements, appState: { pages, activePageId }, captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY }) with a two-page pages list and new elements, one without pageId and one with page 2's pageId
tests.expect: the first element still has no pageId, the second keeps page 2's pageId, and switching to page 2 shows only the second

tests.name: updateScene adding an element puts it on the active page
tests.given: two pages with page 2 active, then API.updateScene({ elements: [...h.app.scene.getElementsIncludingDeleted(), newRect], captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY }) where newRect has no pageId
tests.expect: newRect's pageId is page 2's id and h.app.scene.getNonDeletedElements() includes it

style_from.reason: editor test imports, render, API and window.h assertions

value.behaviour: Collab tests: pages and elements of every page reach a peer, late joiners get all pages, starting a room keeps every page, local autosave restores every page.

tests.name: SCENE_UPDATE carries pages and every page's elements
tests.given: two pages with elements and window.collab.portal.broadcastScene spied on its _broadcastSocketData
tests.expect: the payload holds both pages and the elements of both pages

tests.name: SCENE_INIT for a late joiner holds all pages
tests.given: broadcastScene(WS_SUBTYPES.INIT, all elements, true)
tests.expect: payload.pages lists every page incl. a renamed and a deleted one

tests.name: remote page changes are applied per page
tests.given: handleRemoteSceneUpdate with a remote rename, a remote new page and a remote edit on a non-active page
tests.expect: local pages show the rename and the new page, the non-active page's element is updated, activePageId is unchanged

tests.name: localStorage autosave restores every page
tests.given: two pages saved through LocalData.flushSave
tests.expect: importFromLocalStorage returns appState.pages with both pages and elements of both pages

tests.name: starting a room keeps every page's elements
tests.given: a two-page drawing (one element on each page, page 2 active), vi.mocked(saveToFirebase).mockClear(), window.collab.startCollaboration(null), then window.collab.portal._broadcastSocketData spied and portal.broadcastScene(WS_SUBTYPES.INIT, window.collab.getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted(), true)
tests.expect: h.app.scene.getElementsIncludingDeleted() still holds both elements non-deleted with their pageIds, the saveToFirebase call's elements argument holds both element ids, and the SCENE_INIT payload holds both elements and both pages
